## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō shèngjūn wáng suǒwèn jīng* (T516) is [施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7) Shīhù's Sòng translation parallel to [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng's *Rúlái shìjiào shèngjūn wáng jīng* [KR6i0145](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0145) (T515). Both render the same Indic *Prasenajit-paripṛcchā-sūtra*.

**Abstract**

This is the second Chinese translation of the *Prasenajit-paripṛcchā*. Comparison with Xuánzàng's earlier translation provides another window into the evolution of Buddhist Chinese idiom across three centuries. Translation dated to Shīhù's productive period (989–1017 CE).
